import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_connected_union_rooted {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (A : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ) :
    0 < n →
    (∀ k < n, IsConnected (A k)) →
    (∀ k, 0 < k → k < n → r k < k ∧ (A k ∩ A (r k)).Nonempty) →
    IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro hn
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hn hconn hattach
      by_cases hzero : n = 0
      · subst n
        simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hconn 0 (by omega)
      · have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
        have hprev : IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
          apply ih
          · exact hnpos
          · intro k hk
            exact hconn k (by omega)
          · intro k hkpos hklt
            exact hattach k hkpos (by omega)
        have hlast : IsConnected (A n) := hconn n (by omega)
        have hroot : r n < n ∧ (A n ∩ A (r n)).Nonempty :=
          hattach n (by omega) (by omega)
        have hinter :
            ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∩ A n).Nonempty := by
          rcases hroot.2 with ⟨x, hxlast, hxroot⟩
          refine ⟨x, ?_, hxlast⟩
          simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
          exact ⟨r n, ⟨by simpa [Finset.mem_range] using hroot.1, hxroot⟩⟩
        have hunion :
            IsConnected ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∪ A n) :=
          IsConnected.union hinter hprev hlast
        have heq :
            (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.succ n), A k) =
              (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∪ A n := by
          simp only [Finset.mem_range]
          exact Set.biUnion_lt_succ A n
        simpa only [heq] using hunion

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_connected_union_rooted {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (A : ℕ → Set X) (n : ℕ) (r : ℕ → ℕ) :
    0 < n →
    (∀ k < n, IsConnected (A k)) →
    (∀ k, 0 < k → k < n → r k < k ∧ (A k ∩ A (r k)).Nonempty) →
    IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro hn
      omega
  | succ n ih =>
      intro hn hconn hroot
      by_cases hn0 : n = 0
      · subst n
        simpa using hconn 0 (by omega)
      · have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn0
        have hprev : IsConnected (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) := by
          apply ih hnpos
          · intro k hk
            exact hconn k (lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
          · intro k hkpos hk
            exact hroot k hkpos (lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
        have hrootn := hroot n hnpos (Nat.lt_succ_self n)
        rcases hrootn with ⟨hr, hinter⟩
        have hinter' :
            ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∩ A n).Nonempty := by
          rcases hinter with ⟨x, hx, hxr⟩
          refine ⟨x, ?_, hx⟩
          exact
            mem_iUnion.2
              ⟨r n, mem_iUnion.2 ⟨Finset.mem_range.2 hr, hxr⟩⟩
        have hu :
            IsConnected ((⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∪ A n) :=
          hprev.union hinter' (hconn n (Nat.lt_succ_self n))
        have heq :
            (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range (Nat.succ n), A k) =
              (⋃ k ∈ Finset.range n, A k) ∪ A n := by
          ext x
          simp only [mem_iUnion, Finset.mem_range, mem_union]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨k, hk, hx⟩
            rcases Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt_succ hk) with hkn | rfl
            · exact Or.inl ⟨k, hkn, hx⟩
            · exact Or.inr hx
          · rintro (⟨k, hk, hx⟩ | hx)
            · exact ⟨k, Nat.lt_trans hk (Nat.lt_succ_self n), hx⟩
            · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, hx⟩
        rw [heq]
        exact hu
